extracted.intended_audience: astronomers, astrophysicists, and data center users who need machine-readable stellar spectrophotometry
extracted.subtask_description: Documentation describing the machine-readable version of a catalog of stellar spectrophotometric observations (Adelman et al. 1989), including scope, calibration (Vega fluxes), and wavelength coverage. Intended to guide data users and archivists in understanding and using the distributed dataset.
